note: What a server sends to place a region that follows a unit, showing the map around it until it runs out or the unit is gone.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Whose map shows the region: 0 side 100's, 1 side 200's, 2 everyone's, 3 side 300's, 4 any other. A client takes the value as it stands, so 100 or 200 here matches no one, and draws the region only where it is 2 or names the player's own side.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: sightRadius
fields.note: How far the region shows the map around it, in world units, zero or more. Zero takes the unit's own sight radius, followed as it changes, or a default where it has none.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the region follows: one that fights, such as a champion, a minion or a turret. A client fails where it holds no such unit under this id.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds. A client counts it down and removes the region once it reaches zero or less, so one that starts at zero or less goes at its first count.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: The region's id, which RegionRemoved names; zero has the client pick one of its own.

fields.name: does
fields.note: What the region does.

bits.name: flag
bits.note: Read by no client: the region shows the map whatever this holds. Where kind is 2, a client sets this bit and does.second itself.

bits.name: second
bits.note: Kept with the region; a client also sets it where kind is 2. It changes nothing a client shows.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Its value has no effect, because a client always sets this bit itself; a server writes zero.

fields.name: extra
fields.note: Kept with the region; it changes nothing a client shows. A server writes zero.

fields.note: The unit the region follows. A client drops the whole message where it does not hold the unit.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Its height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds. A client counts it down and removes the region once it reaches zero or less. Whether one that starts at zero or less is kept is not recorded.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: The region's id, which RegionRemoved names.

fields.name: does
fields.note: What the region does.

bits.name: flag
bits.note: What this changes on a client is not recorded.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of region it is. Where it is 2, the region belongs to the client clientId names; what other values mean is not recorded.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client the region belongs to where kind is 2. A client takes 4294967294 as 4294967295, no client.

fields.name: sightRadius
fields.note: How far the region shows the map around it, in world units. Zero takes the unit's own sight radius, or a default where it has none.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the region follows. A client ignores the whole message where it does not hold the unit, or where what it holds under that id is not a unit.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.note: Its height, in world units.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: The region's id, which RegionRemoved names; 4294967295 has the client pick one of its own.

fields.name: does
fields.note: What the region does.

bits.name: flag
bits.note: What this changes on a client is not recorded.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

revisions.note: A region matching one the client holds in marker, kind, sightRadius, does and unit only gives that one the new lifetime.
